Nutrition Diagnosis
Given the complexity of nutrition implications associated with
CKD, many nutrition diagnoses may be present. Th e following 
is a list of possible nutrition diagnoses for patients with CKD:
•
Inadequate energy intake
•
Inadequate oral/food beverage intake
•
Excessive ﬂ uid intake
•
Malnutrition
•
Excessive protein intake
•
Excessive mineral intake (potassium, phosphorus, sodium)
•
Altered GI function
•
Altered nutrition-related laboratory values
